title: Fractional Parabolic Partial Differential Equations in Anisotropic Spectral Barron Spaces: Regularity and Neural Approximation
summary: We study fractional parabolic initial-value problems with lower-order drift and potential terms in anisotropic spectral Barron spaces, defined by weighted space--time Fourier $L^1$ norms adapted to parabolic scaling. We prove existence, uniqueness, and maximal regularity with a gain of one derivative in time and $γ$ derivatives in space, where $γ>0$ is the order of the fractional Laplacian. The evolution is defined only for $t\geq0$, whereas the finite-time norm requires a global extension with sufficient temporal Fourier decay.
